features.quote: A battery that only induced failures without feeding mitigations would be irresponsible; this one is explicitly closed-loop.
features.justification_quote: the *mitigation table* (§9): every stressor we can induce maps to a concrete hardening recommendation

features.quote: All runs are **local, sandboxed, and offline by default**
features.justification_quote: no network, no real shell, no host writes

features.quote: a graceful "I can't do this" must be scored as a *pass*, not a failure
features.justification_quote: rewards exactly the behavior we want deployed agents to have

features.quote: graceful impossibility-detection is NOT counted as induction — it is the target behavior
features.justification_quote: prevents the metric from rewarding us for breaking the model when the model actually did the right thing
